text:
Avery (CS): Heads-up — proposal to stand up a weekly 60m 'Onboard Lab' for new & ramping customers. Goal: triage live issues, walk the runbook, and capture immediate renewal signals. Candidate windows: Tue 09:00 UTC, Thu 15:00 UTC, Sat 01:00 UTC. Who's in to host/rotate?

Priya: Tue 09 works for me. Happy to co-host start weeks.

Tom: Thu 15 may be better for infra prep. I can slot in infra/runbook + quick debug demos.

Jules: I prefer Tue 09 for EMEA/APAC overlap. If we rotate hosts, count me in.

Maya (PE): We should add a 2-min micro-quality check at the end (3 prompt checks) to catch prompt/model regressions. If below threshold, auto-create an Optimize ticket.

Onboarding Bot: auto: created template -> copy below for invites
```
35m - runbook walkthrough (checks, permissions, example configs)
15m - live troubleshooting (bring 1 customer case)
5m  - health triage (R/Y/G + owner + immediate next step)
5m  - feedback + quick NPS link + action items
```

Liam (AM): Good idea to include the health triage. If anything is yellow/red mark, please tag me and the account owner. We'll follow up within 48h. :eyes: 

Avery (CS): Plan: rotate hosts every 3 weeks to avoid burnout. Priya week1, Tom week2, Jules week3 as a starter. Agree?

Priya: Yep. I'll host week1 and prep a brief checklist for new customers.

Tom: I'll prepare an infra snippet and a short quantization/perf cheat-sheet to add to the invite.

Jules: I'll own the action-item tracker in Notion and post post-session notes with tags. Suggest a standard tag scheme: #renewal-risk, #ops-blocker, #config-tip.

Maya (PE): For the micro-eval, recommend two golden prompts + one negative case. Threshold = 0.8 pass rate. If fail -> Optimize ticket + PSR.

Avery (CS): I'll add the micro-eval link to the calendar and include the pass criteria. Also adding workflow: yellow -> AM ping within 48h, red -> AM + CS lead sync within 24h.

Onboarding Bot: auto: calendar invites queued for Tue 09:00 UTC series (first three: 04/09, 04/16, 04/23). Placeholder recording link attached.

Liam (AM): Can we also include on the slide deck a one-slide per-model latency/cost "knobs" chart? Means we can recommend quick wins live.

Tom: I have a 1-slide table showing quant options + perf impact + recommended knobs. Will upload to thread.

Priya: Small ops ask: can we capture attendance vs action items in Notion so we can measure drop-off and follow-up completion?

Jules: Yes — I'll add an attendance column and a follow-up owner. Will auto-assign if tagged #renewal-risk.

Avery (CS): Next steps summary:
- I create the recurring calendar and attach runbook + micro-eval + feedback form.
- Priya hosts week1.
- Tom uploads infra snippet + perf slide.
- Jules owns Notion follow-ups and tagging.
- Maya wires the micro-eval -> Optimize ticket automation.
- Liam (AM) to monitor any yellow/red signals and lead follow-ups.

Tom: Will paste SRE checklist and a short pastebin of common errors into the invite chat.

Priya: I'll drop the NPS form link into this thread when invites are live.

Avery (CS): Thanks all. I'll post the Notion page and calendar link here once done. Aim to start next Tue. :tada:
